name: Dungeon Finder Need on a shield follows the Shield proficiency for a Witch Doctor (#10516)
contract: Issue #10516: a Witch Doctor could roll Need on Aegis of the Scarlet Commander 7726 (shield, all classes) although it cannot equip shields.
Equipping a shield needs the Shield proficiency 9116 (skill 433); SkillLineAbility row 4115 grants it to class mask 0x7F030A00, which includes Sun Cleric 27 but not Witch Doctor 13.
Inside the group's Dungeon Finder dungeon the Need rule for a shield follows that proficiency: no Need for the Witch Doctor without skill 433, Need for the Sun Cleric that holds it.

steps.label: The group is assigned Scarlet Monastery - Graveyard
The Witch Doctor enters Scarlet Monastery
The Sun Cleric enters Scarlet Monastery

SETUP: the Sun Cleric knows Shield
